camera.method: fixed estimated intrinsics from native anchor inferred pointmap

limitations: Source-visible union is a monocular learned-depth observation, not complete rigid reconstruction or repaired SAM.
Original native GLBs, joints and descriptive interaction program remain separate and unchanged.
Only source-visible component-mask regions are represented. Hands, hidden backs, pockets, ports and contact occlusion remain absent.
Per-frame topology/depth can vary. No geometric interpolation or hidden-surface completion.
Visible component IDs require actual retained triangles; absence is not proof object did not exist.
Source RGB reprojection is constructive, not independent3D validation; native depth gauge is not metric.
No rigid joint, contact, grasp, insertion, physical charging or simulation-ready claim.
